speaker: Doctor
text: Given your recent influenza infection, I need to determine if this has progressed to a secondary bacterial pneumonia. Do you have a high fever now, and are you experiencing sharp pain when you take a deep breath? REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Left chest pain. I also have Productive cough with purulent sputum, Shortness of breath. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Cellulitis and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text: Cellulitis typically affects the skin, not the lungs, so that diagnosis seems inconsistent with your cough and sputum. Let's wait for the chest X-ray results to confirm if you have pneumonia.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Diagnosed with influenza recently, with non-compliance to treatment. No other significant past medical or surgical history. Social history: Non-smoker, occasional alcohol intake. Occupation and hobbies not specified.

speaker: Doctor
text: The previous diagnosis of cellulitis is inconsistent with your respiratory symptoms; let's focus on the chest X-ray results to confirm pneumonia. REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count
